summary: Enhance your knowledge with our Financial Regulation and Compliance Best Practices training. Learn essential strategies to navigate complex regulations.
lede: Financial regulation and compliance training helps compliance, AML, KYC and risk professionals turn obligations into practical controls and evidence. It covers mapping regulatory obligations, assessing inherent and residual risk, designing and testing customer due diligence, transaction monitoring and sanctions controls, and documenting investigations, escalations and remediation reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who translate financial regulation into daily controls, evidence, investigations, reporting, and remediation. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured approach rather than jurisdiction-specific legal interpretation.
modules: KYC and Customer Due Diligence Controls
Regulatory Reporting and Basel III Oversight
prerequisites: No formal legal or compliance qualification is required. You should have basic familiarity with financial services operations, internal controls, risk registers, or customer onboarding. Working knowledge of AML, KYC, or regulatory reporting is useful but not essential. Coding is not required. You will use structured spreadsheet and dashboard exercises rather than build software or deploy compliance models.
